title: Billing: add daily meter reconciliation workflow (scheduled job + Slack summary)
author: Nadia Rahman
description: Context: Finance + Telemetry have been doing manual/sampled reconciliation during the metering sanity-checks push. This PR adds an automated *daily* reconciliation workflow that compares raw telemetry aggregates vs billing-ready aggregates, writes an audit-friendly summary, and alerts when deltas exceed tolerance. This is intended to (a) catch regressions earlier than month-end close, and (b) produce a consistent evidence trail for sign-off. What this adds: 1) New scheduled job `meter_reconciliation_daily` (runs 06:30 UTC) that executes a fixed set of reconciliation queries for Hosted API meters (tokens in/out/cached, embeddings, rerank units, request counts) and produces per-dimension diffs. 2) Output tables: `billing_controls.reconciliation_runs` (one row per run; includes run_id, window_start/window_end, git_sha, query_versions, status, totals) and `billing_controls.reconciliation_diffs` (diff rows; includes meter_name, customer_id, workspace_id, model_family, model, region, endpoint_type, aggregation_window, raw_units, billable_units, abs_delta, pct_delta). 3) Slack summary + alerting integration: posts a compact summary to `#finance` and `#eng-sre` and raises an alert when thresholds are exceeded (configurable per meter and per dimension). Alerts link to the dashboard + runbook section in Confluence (Finance/Legal > RevRec & Billing > Meter reconciliation). 4) Configuration: adds `config/meter_reconciliation.yml` with default tolerances (tokens: 0.25% or 2,000 tokens minimum, embeddings: 0.10% or 50 units, rerank: 0.10% or 10 units), plus allowlists/denylists for noisy segments (e.g., internal load test workspaces). 5) Safety controls: (a) suppress alerts when `backfill=true` (explicit flag), (b) cap cardinality by limiting diff emission to top-N deltas per meter/dimension, and (c) hard-fail when required dimensions are missing (prevents silently producing misleading “zero diff” summaries). Notes/decisions: - This job compares *aggregated* raw telemetry (by request_id rollup) to the billing-ready aggregates. It does not attempt request-by-request matching (too expensive for a daily run). - Time window is the previous UTC day (00:00–24:00 UTC). Console alignment and invoice timezone normalization are handled elsewhere; this job is strictly a control for metering pipeline correctness. - Rounding: reconciliation operates on unrounded units and reports deltas on raw integer unit counts (consistent with ADR direction); invoice-level rounding/formatting is out of scope here. Testing: - Added unit tests for query templating + dimension projection. - Added an integration-style “golden” test that runs reconciliation against a small replay dataset in CI (sanitized) and asserts stable output schema + key metrics within tolerance. Rollout: - Job is deployed disabled by default; enable via `BILLING_CONTROLS_RECONCILIATION_ENABLED=true` in prod after Finance sign-off. - Once enabled, we’ll watch for 3 business days and tune tolerances before making the alert policy paging (currently non-paging notifications only). Follow-ups: - Hook run_id into the invoice run metadata (`invoice_run_id`) once that lands (tracked in ENG-4825/PR 41966). - Extend to Dedicated attribution checks once the Hosted API meters are stable (separate ticket).
commits: billing-controls: scaffold reconciliation job runner + CLI entrypoint
sql: add daily reconciliation queries (raw vs billing-ready aggregates)
alerts: Slack summary formatter + threshold-based alert emission
tests: add golden dataset + CI integration check
review_conversation: Logan Wright (review): Love the direction. Two questions: (1) can we ensure we’re not comparing apples-to-oranges with retries? raw telemetry aggregate needs to use the same billed/non-billed filter as billing-ready. (2) Please include request_outcome breakdown in the diff output so we can quickly see if failures are leaking in. Nadia Rahman (author): (1) good catch — updated the raw aggregate to apply the same `is_billable=true` predicate used in billing-ready, and added an explicit guard that fails if the predicate is missing from the compiled query. (2) request_outcome isn’t available end-to-end yet (ENG-4823). I added `request_outcome` to the diff schema as nullable and logged it as a follow-up; once events carry it, the query will automatically populate. Emily Stone (review): Finance needs the Slack message to include the *top offenders* (accounts/workspaces) and a single green/red status so it’s scannable. Also please add a note on how to interpret small deltas (expected noise) vs actual defects. Nadia Rahman: Updated Slack summary to include (a) overall status, (b) top 5 deltas by abs_delta and pct_delta per meter, and (c) the tolerance used. Added a short “Interpretation” section to the runbook with examples (duplication vs missing dims vs late-arriving events). Allison Grant (review): Alert routing: please don’t page SRE on first rollout. Also we should suppress alerts during backfills and large warehouse maintenance windows; otherwise false positives will train people to ignore them. Nadia Rahman: Agreed. Alerts are non-paging Slack notifications only, and `backfill=true` suppresses alert emission. Added `maintenance_window` support to config (list of UTC ranges) and documented it. Cole Summers (review): Minor: rename `run_id` to `reconciliation_run_id` in the output tables so it’s unambiguous when we join with invoice_run_id later. Nadia Rahman: Done; updated schema + downstream references and regenerated golden files. Logan Wright (final): Looks good. Once enabled, we should keep an eye on cardinality limits to ensure we don’t hide meaningful tail issues. Approved.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Nadia Rahman after approvals; rollout flag left disabled pending Finance sign-off.
